verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents bulk and asynchronous insert strategies and now parallelizes INSERT SELECT by default, so bulk ingestion and set-based writes across many rows are first-party capabilities. Hands-on users confirm ingesting billions of rows quickly, but one also reports limited DELETE support, so bulk modification is less proven than bulk insertion. Missing for 10: documented bulk update/delete operations, detail on bulk operations driven through AI-agent interfaces (MCP/CLI), and in-depth docs beyond the insert-strategy summary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
